name: Ring Road (1) through Hornafjörður
law: Spölur ehf.'s price list for the new Ring Road (1) section through Hornafjörður, single trips: vehicles of 3.5-7.5 t ISK 2100, over 7.5 t ISK 4500, by the total weight in the vehicle register; Vegagerðin's notice of 31 August 2026: collected from 2026-09-01, the same prices. Free-flow (cameras at the section's ends); placed at the longest bridge of the ways OpenStreetMap tags toll=yes there (the one over Hornafjarðarfljót), which a trip through the section crosses. Monthly discounts (for vehicles up to 7.5 t) aren't modelled.

sources.title: Vegagerðin: Hornafjörður Ring road tolls collected from September 1st onwards

tolled_roads: The new Ring Road (1) section through Hornafjörður, with its bridge over Hornafjarðarfljót.
